kmskey.description: The name of the KmsKey to use to encrypt the message at rest and in flight. Defaults to the Tenant's KmsKey.

message_type.description: The MessageType that will be transmitted.

queue.description: The URL of the underlying AWS SQS queue.

source.description: The source Node to transmit messages from.

image_uri.description: The URI of the Docker image. Must be a [public](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/public/public-repositories.html) or a [private](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/Repositories.html) AWS ECR repository.

protocol.description: The protocol to use for the port. One of `sctp`, `tcp` or `udp`.

port_requirements.description: The port requirements of the Docker image.

auditor.description: A Python code string that contains a single top-level function definition. This function must have the signature `(*, message, **kwargs)` where message is a string and must return a flat dictionary.

bitmapper_template.description: A Python code string that contains a single top-level function definition. This function is used as a template when creating custom routing rules in RouterNodes that use this MessageType. This function must have the signature `(*, context, message, source, **kwargs)` and return an integer.

This function must have the signature `(*, context, message, source, **kwargs)` and return `None`, a string or a list of strings.

return_message_type.description: The MessageType returned by the Function.
